'''Tydis Neutronics Warehouse''' was a warehouse of the [[Tydis Neutronics]] company located on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] raided the warehouse to procure the cure for the [[Rot]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tydis Neutronics Warehouse appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission.<ref name="SWTOR" />
